## What managing Wicker Park takes.

### Landmark Victorians off the park
The Wicker Park Landmark District's mansions on Hoyne and Pierce, many long since divided into condominiums, need slate, masonry, and millwork vendors who respect the architecture. We keep exactly those trades on call.

### The 606 effect
Property values along the Bloomingdale Trail have climbed for a decade, and buyers expect buildings to match. We help boards fund the tuckpointing, roofs, and common-area upgrades that keep trail-adjacent buildings competitive.

### Six Corners energy
Around Milwaukee, North, and Damen, condos sit above bars and storefronts. We manage the mixed-use realities, shared utilities, late-night noise, trash logistics, that come with living at the center of the action.

## Wicker Park boards ask us first.

### Do you manage converted three-flats and small condo buildings in Wicker Park?
Yes. Much of Wicker Park's condo stock is vintage two-to-six-flat conversions, and our flat monthly fee starting at $20 per unit is designed so buildings that size get professional management, transparent books, and 24/7 emergency coverage without big-building overhead.

### Our building sits above retail on Milwaukee Avenue, can CenterPoint manage it?
Yes. We manage mixed-use condominium buildings and handle the extra layers they involve: cost allocations with commercial owners, shared building systems, and operating rules that keep the residential floors livable above active storefronts.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Wicker Park?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Wicker Park, Chicago (ZIP 60622, 60647). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Wicker Park?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Wicker Park association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access.
